title: 1959 AHSME Problem 1

concepts.label: Power scaling of length, area, and volume

statement: Each edge of a cube is increased by \(50\%.\) The percent of increase of the surface area of the cube is:

solutions.text:
If the original edge length is \(s,\) the new edge length is \(1.5s.\) Thus the surface area is multiplied by \[ (1.5)^2=2.25. \] The increase is \(1.25\) times the original area, or \(125\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Compare the new edge length with the old edge length
Surface area changes by the square of the linear scale factor
